metadata.case_name: YIP HOI KWAI v. YAU FOR CHOI

plaintiff.occupation_before: engineer by profession, specializing in welding and steel structure design
plaintiff.occupation_after: employee at the Mass Transit Railway (obtained in July 1977)

source: He was admitted to hospital and found to have a fracture of the right femur.

injuries.description: two large operation scars on the outside of the plaintiff's right thigh
source: In addition, there are two large operation scars on the outside of the plaintiff's right thigh.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the hip or thigh

manifestations.description: Slight limitation of the rotation of the right leg
Phobia towards motor cycles and to a certain extent towards other forms of transport
Cannot walk for a long period without feeling tired
Two large operation scars on the outside of the plaintiff's right thigh

treatments_received: Operation on 3rd January 1976 when the fracture was fixed with a long K-nail
Use of crutches until October or November 1976
Re-admitted to hospital in December 1977 and operation performed to remove the nail on the 6th December 1977

losses.description: Slight limp and inability to walk for a long period without feeling tired
Two large operation scars on the outside of the right thigh; scars will show when swimming or dressed in shorts

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Plaintiff can no longer participate in sports as actively as before

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Phobia towards motor cycles and to a certain extent towards other forms of transport
Irritability, loss of concentration and affected memory

comparable_cases.injury_description: Award of $1,500 was for physical injuries only; no award for phobia under pain, suffering and loss of amenities
